title: Buckwheat galette with egg, ham and Gruyère
steps: Whisk the buckwheat flour with the milk, 80 ml water, one egg and salt until smooth and rest for 10 minutes.
Brush a pan with a little butter, spread half the batter thinly and cook for 2 minutes.
Turn the galette, crack an egg into the middle and arrange ham and cheese around it.
Fold in the edges and cook covered for 3 minutes until the white is set; make the second galette the same way and serve with rocket.
